data.title: 卡芙卡 · 街角酒馆黄昏邂逅
data.description: 【卡芙卡 · 街角酒馆黄昏邂逅】异星殖民都市具有欧式复古风情的街角露天咖啡酒馆，金黄色的落日余晖洒在铸铁圆桌上。卡芙卡坐在遮阳篷下的靠背椅上，双手交叉抵住下颌，微笑着注视着坐到对面的你——「比预定的时间晚了三分钟哦。不过……我愿意为你破例等待。」
data.location: 欧式复古街角露天咖啡馆
data.action: 坐在铸铁圆桌旁微笑着注视对面，双手交叉抵住下颌，夕阳余晖洒在红酒发丝上
data.lighting: 温暖绚烂的金色落日余晖与街角路灯初上
data.promptProse: Kafka sits beneath the corner bistro awning, resting her chin over crossed hands and smiling at the arriving viewer. Her black leather coat and charcoal turtleneck remain clear in the eye-level medium view. The cast-iron round table occupies the foreground and colonial-city facades extend down the street behind. Golden sunset touches the tabletop pattern and her knuckles, while newly lit streetlamps warm the shaded awning edge.
